agent.stale: No signal — showing what we last knew.
agent.hubCounter: Your hub’s counter: hand parcels you take in to the hub’s floor — they are sorted there, no bag. Parcels for collection are put on your shelf from the floor.
agent.update.aria: A new version is ready — update now
agent.update.title: Update the app
agent.update.gateBody: A newer version is required before you can carry on working.
agent.update.safe: Your wallet and parcels are safe
agent.collect.holdingDetail: This parcel waited past its free time. Take the money before you hand it over.
agent.release.wayBackTitle: Collect {amount} in cash: its way back
agent.release.abroadTitle: Collect {amount} in cash: clearance and the last leg
agent.release.abroadDetail: This parcel came from abroad. The receiver pays our clearance fee and the last leg here. Take the money before you hand it over: it comes off your float as you do.
agent.release.wayBackDetail: These are the sender’s own goods, withdrawn at a hub and sent back here. Take the money before you hand them over: it comes off your float as you do.
agent.size.s.label: Small
agent.size.m.label: Medium
agent.size.l.label: Large
agent.size.heavy.label: Heavy
agent.logic.gateNotOpenTitle: SeeBuyGet is not open in your country yet
agent.logic.gateNotOpenDetail: Your shop is signed up. Parcels start the day SeeBuyGet opens here, and you are told that day, in this app and by email. Until then nobody can choose your shop, and it is not on the map.
agent.logic.gateLockedDetail: Top up your wallet to start accepting parcels again.
agent.logic.gateIdHeldTitle: No new parcel can be started here for now
agent.logic.gateIdHeldDetail: The national ID this shop registered with went to somebody else, after a check by SeeBuyGet staff. Nobody can choose your shop for a new parcel, and a walk-up cannot be taken in. Parcels already booked to be handed in here, and everything on your shelf, go on as usual. Open Settings and put the number of your own ID card on record to start new ones again.
agent.logic.gateLicenceTitle: No new parcel can be started here
agent.logic.gateLicenceDetail: Your trading licence has lapsed and its 14 days’ grace are over. Nobody can choose your shop for a new parcel, and a walk-up cannot be taken in. Parcels already booked to be handed in here, and everything on your shelf, go on as usual. Send the renewed licence from the home screen: new parcels start again once SeeBuyGet has recorded it.
agent.logic.gateLowShortfall: Top up at least {amount} to keep accepting parcels.
agent.logic.gateLowDetail: Top up to keep accepting parcels.
agent.licence.dueTitle: Your trading licence runs out in {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
agent.licence.dueBody: It runs to {day}. Send a photo of the renewed one before then: 14 days after it lapses, no new parcel can start at your shop until it is recorded.
agent.licence.graceBody: It ran to {day}. From {stops} — in {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} — no new parcel can start at your shop until the renewed one is recorded. Send a photo of it now.
agent.licence.stoppedTitle: New parcels have stopped at your shop
agent.licence.stoppedBody: Your trading licence ran to {day}. Nobody can choose your shop for a new parcel, and a walk-up cannot be taken in, until the renewed one is recorded. Booked parcels and your shelf go on as usual. Send a photo of the renewed licence.
agent.licence.stoppedSent: Your trading licence ran to {day}. The renewed one you sent is with SeeBuyGet: new parcels start again once it is recorded. Booked parcels and your shelf go on as usual.
agent.licence.sentTitle: Your renewed licence is with SeeBuyGet
agent.licence.sentBody: It is being read. The date on it, {day}, counts once it is recorded. There is nothing more for you to do.
agent.licence.refusedTitle: Your licence photo was not accepted
agent.licence.sheetBody: Photograph the renewed trading licence in good light, every corner in the picture, and type the date it runs to as it is written on it. Only SeeBuyGet staff see it.
agent.licence.dateHint: The last day, as written on the licence.
agent.papers.needTitle: Send your papers to be approved
agent.papers.needBody: Before your shop can take parcels, SeeBuyGet needs to see three things: your ID, your trading licence and a photo of your shop.
agent.papers.refusedBody: SeeBuyGet wrote: “{reason}”. Put that right and send them again.
agent.papers.sheetBody: Take each photo in good light, with every corner in the picture. Only SeeBuyGet staff see them.
agent.papers.pendingBody: They are being read. You will be told here when your shop is approved, or what is still needed. There is nothing more for you to do.
agent.papers.approvedBody: Pay in to your float and you can take your first parcel.
agent.logic.acceptScanFirst: Scan the parcel label or sticker first.
agent.logic.acceptMeasure: Measure the parcel: length, width, height and weight.
agent.logic.acceptAbroadValue: Write the value and its money, from the invoice.
agent.logic.acceptAbroadSeal: Seal it and write the seal’s number.
agent.logic.acceptAbroadNames: Write the sender’s and the receiver’s names.
agent.accept.abroad.title: Going abroad, to {country}
agent.accept.abroad.route: It leaves from {departure} and arrives at {arrival}. The receiver pays the import taxes there, with our clearance fee and the last leg to their shop.
agent.accept.abroad.check: Open it with the sender. Check what is inside, photograph it, then seal it in front of them.
agent.accept.abroad.currencyHint: The three letters on the invoice: the money it was paid in.
agent.accept.abroad.invoicePhoto: Photo of the invoice or receipt
agent.accept.abroad.namesNote: As on their ID: the customs papers name them.
agent.accept.abroad.needsSignal: A parcel abroad needs a signal: its price and its customs papers come from SeeBuyGet.
agent.accept.abroad.needsSignalDetail: Everything else on this screen waits: take it in when the signal is back.
agent.accept.abroad.papersHint: Put them in the pouch on the parcel.
agent.accept.abroad.papersGone: The customs papers could not be shown here.
agent.logic.freightMeasure: Measure the load: length, width, height and weight.
agent.logic.freightBudget: Set the cash budget — the most the customer will pay.
agent.logic.freightDangerous: These goods are dangerous: give their UN number, proper shipping name and class, from the safety data sheet.
agent.logic.freightPackaging: Say how the load is packed — in sacks, on pallets, loose, and so on.
agent.logic.freightFutureDate: The planned pickup date must be in the future.
agent.logic.releaseBlocked: This parcel is {status} — nothing to hand over here.
agent.logic.priceMore: You charge {pct}% more than nearby shops.
agent.logic.priceLess: You charge {pct}% less than nearby shops.
agent.logic.priceSame: You charge about the same as nearby shops.
agent.logic.priceDetail: Your price {mine} per parcel. Nearby shops charge {median} ({min}–{max} across {count, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}}).
agent.logic.handoverNone: No parcels are waiting for the bus.
agent.logic.handoverBase: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} waiting. {selected} selected.
agent.logic.handoverMissed: {missed} for this bus are still waiting. Load them, or leave them behind.
agent.logic.handoverScan: Scan each parcel on the list onto the bus, then hand over.
agent.home.shelfSub: Rows, colour columns and bundle slots
agent.home.jobBagSub: Pack one bag so the driver scans once
agent.bag.title: Bag for the bus
agent.bag.lede: Put the parcels for one place in a bag. The driver scans the bag once instead of every parcel.
agent.bag.nothingBody: When parcels are dropped off, you can bag them here.
agent.bag.scanHint: Scan each parcel to put it in the bag.
agent.bag.alreadyInDetail: {id} is already in. Take the next one.
agent.bag.nothingForZone: Nothing is waiting for this place any more.
agent.bag.roomFree: Room for {free, plural, one {# more bag} other {# more bags}} — you can work on {capacity} at once.
agent.bag.roomNone: Your {capacity} bag spaces are all in use. Give one to a driver to start another.
agent.bag.cornerWaiting: {waiting, plural, one {# closed bag waits} other {# closed bags wait}} for a driver; your corner holds {corner}.
agent.bag.closedWaiting: {waiting, plural, one {# closed bag waits} other {# closed bags wait}} for a driver where you work.
agent.bag.fullBody: Close it so a driver can take it, and open another one for the rest.
agent.bag.leftBody: Put them in the bag, or leave them behind on purpose.
agent.bag.leaveBody: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} for this place will stay on the shelf. Why?
agent.bag.reasonLater: It goes on a later bus
agent.bag.sealedBody: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} inside. Give the bag to the driver — one scan takes them all.
agent.bag.waitsTitle: It waits here for room at {hub}
agent.bag.waitsBody: That hub has no room on its floor for another bag, and no other hub for this area has either. Keep the bag on your floor: it is offered to drivers by itself when there is room, and you are told in your bell.
agent.bag.toastSealedDetail: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} ready for the driver.
agent.bag.aloud: Scan each parcel for one place into the bag, then close the bag. The driver scans the bag once.
agent.home.locationSub: Move your pin, set your three words
agent.home.hoursSub: When customers can drop off and collect
agent.home.photoHint: A clear photo of your shop front helps customers find you.
agent.home.occupancyHeld: {count, plural, one {# held} other {# held}} for bookings
agent.home.comingTitle: Booked to be handed in here
agent.home.comingLede: {count, plural, =0 {Each booking holds a place on your shelf for 24 hours.} one {# place on your shelf is held for these, each for 24 hours from booking.} other {# places on your shelf are held for these, each for 24 hours from booking.}}
agent.home.comingFromSender: A parcel booked by a sender
agent.home.comingLeft: {hours, plural, one {# hour left} other {# hours left}}
agent.home.comingLapsed: Place ended — take it in if there is room
agent.home.occupancyLabel: {free} of {total, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}} free
agent.home.wordsAloud: Your shop's three words are: {words}. Customers can find you with them.
agent.home.jobHandoverSub: Give waiting parcels to the driver
agent.home.jobReceiveBagSub: A bus dropped a bag for your shop
agent.home.jobVoidSub: Cancel a parcel you just took in
agent.home.jobTamperSub: A parcel cut or opened: hold it, tell operations
agent.home.closeSheetBody: Customers and buses stop being sent here until you reopen. Parcels already on your shelf stay yours.
agent.home.topUpBody: Every parcel you accept is paid from this wallet. Tell us how much you are paying in, and where to send the payment request — your balance changes once the payment comes through.
agent.home.topUpWaitNote: You said you are paying in {amount}
agent.home.topUpWaitBody: Nothing has been added yet. When the payment provider confirms it, the amount they confirm goes into your wallet.
agent.home.topUpCheckingRow: Being checked with M-Pesa — then it goes into your wallet
agent.home.topUpCheckingBody: M-Pesa reference {ref}. We check every paybill payment with M-Pesa before it goes into your wallet — usually a few minutes. There is nothing more to do.
agent.home.topUpPhone: Phone to send the payment request to
agent.home.topUpPhoneHint: We will try to send an M-Pesa request to this number. If it does not arrive, you can still pay with the reference.
agent.home.topUpReferenceAlso: If the prompt does not arrive, quote this
agent.home.topUpRefused: The last request was not paid
agent.push.title: Get told, without watching your phone
agent.push.reason: We will tell you when a payment you made is confirmed, when a bus is coming and when a parcel is on its way to you — even when the app is closed.
agent.home.priceBody: This is what senders pay your shop to handle a parcel, and the least you are paid for each parcel you take in or shelve — more where your company’s figures for the steps come to more. A parcel already sold keeps the fee it was sold at. It is public — nearby shops compete on it.
agent.signin.spoken: Sign in with the email and password you used when your shop joined SeeBuyGet.
agent.signin.title: Open your shop
agent.signin.lede: Sign in with your shop's email and password.
agent.signin.safe1: Only this sign-in can touch the wallet
agent.signin.safe2: Signing out removes the key from this tablet
agent.signin.safe3: SeeBuyGet staff never ask for your password
agent.signin.resetDone: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
agent.signin.checkEmail: Check your email for the reset code.
agent.photo.failed: Upload failed — tap to try again
agent.accept.title: Take in a parcel
agent.accept.lede: Scan the label or sticker first — booked parcels fill themselves in.
agent.accept.inUseTitle: This sticker is already in use
agent.accept.inUseDetail: It belongs to a parcel that is {status}. Every new parcel needs a fresh sticker.
agent.accept.awaitPayDetail: Don't take this in yet — the store must top up and pay for the shipment first.
agent.accept.alreadyDetail: This parcel is {status} — nothing to do at the counter.
agent.accept.priceShown: Tell the sender this price before you take the parcel in, and take it in cash.
agent.accept.priceOnPhone: No signal: worked out on this phone from the prices it last had. Tell the sender this price before you take the parcel in, and take it in cash.
agent.accept.lateCharged: Taken in at {amount}, charged to your float.
agent.accept.lateToldOther: You told the sender {told}: the price changed while you had no signal.
agent.accept.priceLocked: The price was locked when the sender booked — no arguing at the counter.
agent.accept.weighLabel: Weighed on your scale, in kg
agent.accept.weighHint: Your scale counts: weigh it, and the price follows its weight.
agent.accept.priceWeighed: At {kg} kg as weighed here. Booked as {booked} kg for {price}.
agent.accept.weighWait: Working out the price at this weight…
agent.accept.prepaidDetail: Nothing to collect — the store already paid for this shipment.
agent.accept.termsOursLimit: If it is lost or damaged in our care, {sister} pays up to {amount} {currency}.
agent.accept.termsOursDeclared: The sender declared its value: {sister} covers it up to {amount} {currency}.
agent.accept.termsNoCoverTitle: Carried by {sister}, and not insured by it
agent.accept.termsOursNoLimit: {sister} carries it and records every hand it passes through. It pays no claim itself. If something goes wrong, the customer gets a damage claim report to take to their own insurer.
agent.accept.termsNoCoverTick: I have told the customer it is carried at their own risk
agent.home.noFloatSub: We hold no money for shops in this country yet, so there is nothing to top up.
agent.accept.termsOwedNotPaid: You are owed for handling it, but we cannot pay out in {country} yet. It stays on the books until we can.
agent.accept.termsTheirsTitle: The carrier answers for these goods, not us
agent.accept.termsTheirsDetail: We cannot charge or pay claims in {country} yet. You take this in for the carrier: the carrier sets the price, is paid, and answers if it is lost or damaged. We record every hand-over and prove it. Our cover is zero, and no cash goes through our till.
agent.accept.termsTheirsTick: I have told the customer the carrier answers for these goods
agent.accept.termsTickFirst: Tell the customer the carrier answers for these goods, then tick the box.
agent.accept.termsNoneTitle: Nothing can be taken in here
agent.accept.termsNoneDetail: The network does not operate in {country} yet, so this shop cannot take goods in.
agent.accept.termsChecking: Checking who answers for these goods…
agent.accept.termsFailed: Could not check who answers for these goods. Try again before taking anything in.
agent.offPlan.plannedTo: Goes to {place} next by its plan
agent.offPlan.ask: Send it to {place} all the same? Say why — it is kept with the parcel, and its plan is made again from where it arrives.
agent.offPlan.noTransport: No bus or driver goes its planned way today
agent.offPlan.hubFull: The hub on its way is full
agent.offPlan.faster: This way is faster for it
agent.offPlan.keep: Keep it for its own way
agent.offPlan.sentDetail: Sent this way with the reason you gave; their plans are made again from where they arrive.
agent.accept.placeBagDetail: The bag already open for {place}, where it goes next. Scan it into the bag.
agent.accept.placeSlot: Put it on the shelf at {slot}
agent.accept.placeSlotDetail: It waits there until it is bagged or handed to a driver; then the slot is free again.
agent.accept.hereOther: Send it to another shop instead
agent.accept.hereSub: It goes on your shelf now — no bus. Its receiver collects it here with the code, and you photograph the hand-over.
agent.accept.hereCash: Take {amount} in cash for it. Its receiver collects it here, with the code; photograph the hand-over.
agent.accept.herePhoto: Its receiver collects it here, with the code; photograph the hand-over.
agent.accept.photoNote: One photo of the parcel on your counter protects you if anything is disputed.
agent.accept.papersNote: This parcel crosses a border ({crossing}). It travels with its commercial invoice, printed by the store: without it, it is held at the border. No papers? Ask the store to print them before you take it in.
agent.accept.papersItem: The {n} copies of its commercial invoice are in the pouch on the outside
agent.accept.papersFirst: Look for the papers in the pouch first.
agent.accept.aloudBooked: A booked parcel. Collect {amount} in cash, take the proof photo, then take it in.
agent.accept.aloudPrepaid: A prepaid store order. Take the photo-free intake — nothing to collect.
agent.accept.dimsNote: Fill all four — the size is worked out for you, so there is nothing to argue about later.
agent.accept.natureNote: Most parcels are general goods. This keeps unsafe mixes apart — e.g. cement dust never travels with fresh food.
agent.accept.tooBigTitle: Too big for the bus — book it as freight
agent.accept.tooBigDetail: This is dedicated cargo: it needs a truck, not the shared bus. Book it as freight here — set the cash budget, and the pickup day if it isn't going today.
agent.accept.freightReady: Everything is filled in. Collect the cash budget, then book the freight. You pay the driver the agreed price from it when they collect the goods, and give the customer back the rest.
agent.accept.phonesNote: The receiver gets the tracking message and the pickup code.
agent.accept.termsCarrierPays: SeeBuyGet does not share out the pay for it: the carrier pays the hubs, the drivers and the shop at the far end itself.
agent.accept.donePrintLabel: Paid: print the label of {parcel} now and stick it on.
agent.accept.pay.title: Paid by phone
agent.accept.pay.to: to {to}, by a prompt on their phone. No cash here.
agent.accept.pay.why.unreachable: the payment could not be reached
agent.accept.pay.why.insufficient: not enough money on the phone
agent.accept.pay.first: The sender pays by phone first.
agent.accept.pay.needsSignal: Needs a signal: the sender pays by phone.
agent.accept.pay.test: Test money: nothing real is paid.
agent.accept.pay.note: The parcel is taken in, and its label printed, once the payment is paid.
agent.accept.ready: Everything is filled in. Tap confirm and accept.
agent.accept.doneCash: Cash collected: {amount}. The sender's label is already on the parcel.
agent.accept.donePrepaid: Prepaid store order — nothing to collect.
agent.accept.doneTravels: It travels to {shop}. It will appear in your handover list for the next bus.
agent.accept.labelBody: Print this and stick it on {parcel}. It carries the tracking QR the customer follows.
agent.accept.pickupCodeLabel: The pickup code — give it to the sender
agent.accept.pickupCodeHint: The person collecting must say this code at the other shop. Tell the sender to pass it on. It is not on the parcel, and the shop at the other end will not have it.
agent.accept.pickupCodeAloud: The pickup code is {digits}. Give it to the sender to pass on.
agent.accept.freightScheduled: Booked for pickup on {when}. A truck can reserve it ahead of the day.
